sources.relevant_excerpt: The Schengen visa C is intended for touristic, business or visiting purposes (without gainful employment) for a maximum stay of 90 days per 180 days. Nationals of those states for which the visa requirement has been lifted by means of an EU regulation are entitled to visa-free entry to Austria for a maximum of 90 days per 180 days in case of no gainful employment. Please check the information on whether you require a visa or not on the website of the Federal Ministry of the Interior. [Visa applicants must present] a valid passport not older than 10 years, valid for three months after expiry of the visa and with two free pages. [Schengen visa fee] EUR 90; ages 6-12: EUR 45; exempt: children under 6, students/pupils on study trips, researchers, non-profit representatives under 25. Applications must be submitted at the competent Austrian Consulate which is placed in the country where the applicant legally resides. As a rule, the processing time of an admissible Schengen visa application should not exceed 15 calendar days.

sources.relevant_excerpt: Das Europaeische Reiseinformations- und -genehmigungssystem (ETIAS) ist derzeit noch nicht in Betrieb. Visumbefreite Drittstaatsangehoerige muessen voraussichtlich ab Quartal 4/2026 mit Aenderungen bei der Einreise in das Schengengebiet rechnen. Ab diesem Zeitpunkt benoetigen visumbefreite Drittstaatsangehoerige eine ETIAS-Reisegenehmigung, um in das Schengengebiet einzureisen. Die Beantragung kostet sieben Euro, wobei einige Reisende von der Gebuehr befreit sind. Die Beantragung einer ETIAS-Reisegenehmigung erfolgt durch das Ausfuellen des Antragsformulars ueber die offizielle ETIAS-Website oder die mobile ETIAS-Anwendung. [Official website referenced: travel-europe.europa.eu]
